caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sled viewed from an angled perspective, showing both the top and a section of the sides. The sled has long, narrow wooden runners which are brown with black strips near the ends. The top platform of the sled is painted bright red and features black decorative borders and a central motif of a yellow and green leaf or floral design. On each side of the main deck, there are wooden handles attached to the runners, and a gray rope is looped through holes at the front for pulling the sled. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset illustration in grayscale showing the underside of the sled, including the runners, crossbars, and the path of the rope. The drawing is rendered on a cream-colored background, and outlined by straight, thin borders. The artist's name, “Francis Law Durand,” is written in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Child's Sled
